mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO, signaling strengthening industrial production, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recessionary periods with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, indicating a strong housing market, boosts consumer wealth and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and a low CPIAUCSL (< 250) creates a 'low-inflation tightening' scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of 'low-inflation tightening' scenarios, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 1-month drop in UNRATE (< -0.5pp), indicating a rapidly improving labor market, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with a sudden UNRATE drop, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high RSAFS (> $500B) and rising GDPC1 (> 2% QoQ) creates a 'fiscal boost' scenario, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of 'fiscal boost' scenarios during recessions, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 5-year rolling window.
